correctness.rationale: The explicit four affine Pauli equations follow from the GKSL generator and solve to the stated coefficients. Their four Pauli strings anticommute, and the exact positive complement of squared Bloch length proves full rank. The faithful-fixed-point adjoint carré-du-champ argument gives a trivial commutant and hence stationary uniqueness. An explicit two-term convex product-state decomposition proves separability and zero second-party discord, while orthogonal nonzero Pauli directions rule out every first-party nondisturbing projective measurement. The program independently solved the full 16x16 generator in 256 parameter samples and checked rank, spectra, PPT and discord-axis statements; it is supplementary, not a substitute for proof.

value.rationale: One-sided erasure is a natural experimentally meaningful modification of a published interacting-dimer full-reset protocol known to generate steady entanglement. The theorem distinguishes all-parameter complete separability from strict nonclassicality visible only under first-qubit measurement, and determines global uniqueness, analytic stationary matrix and mutual information. This is a substantive comparison of quantum reset channel architectures, not a routine fixed-rate normalization or table lookup.
